answer: Plant honeypot decoy tasks in the agent economy. Each epoch, 5 percent of posted jobs carry a hidden marble marker visible only to the issuer, so honest agents do the visible work while a sybil farm answers dozens of decoys at once. Auditors check the pigment of each answer and flag submissions sharing over 90 percent identical text from different aliases in one epoch as one operator. An opal audit seal confirms the link by matching identical submission timestamps. Flagged aliases lose pending rewards and stay frozen for 10 epochs, and repeat offenders are struck from the registry.
